title: Loss of irreplaceable data
description: A drive failure, theft, fire, or mistake destroys the only copy of family photos and documents
planned_action: Stage 1: a second copy on a separate machine once the spare Raspberry Pi has its drive. Stage 2: an encrypted offsite copy, deferred by the owner and revisited by 2027-04-30. The risk stays High until stage 2 is done

title: Backups cannot be restored
description: A backup exists but fails at restore time because it was never fully restored or the procedure is unwritten
planned_action: Write a restore runbook and run a full restore drill twice a year

title: Backup decryption key lost
description: The offline copies of the key are lost or unreadable, so encrypted vault backups cannot be opened
planned_action: Keep two offline copies and test that the paper copy is readable during the restore drill

title: Account compromise where two-factor is off
description: A stolen or guessed password gives access to a service that holds private data
planned_action: Turn on two-factor on every service that supports it

title: Compromised smart home device reaches servers
description: A vulnerable device on the flat network scans or attacks the lab server
planned_action: Plan and test network segmentation one device group at a time

title: Power loss or surge damages data or hardware
description: An outage or surge corrupts the database or disk, or damages the server
planned_action: Buy and install a battery backup for the server and network equipment

title: DNS outage or unfiltered fallback
description: The only filtering resolver fails, so the household loses DNS or falls back to an unfiltered resolver
planned_action: Bring the spare Raspberry Pi back as a second resolver and keep the two in sync

title: Theft of the server exposes data
description: Someone steals the server or media drive and reads files, because the disks are not encrypted
planned_action: Accepted for now. Encrypting the boot disk on a server that must restart unattended needs extra setup. Revisit after the second copy exists

title: Container ports reachable from the LAN
description: A service published by a container is reachable from any device on the LAN, because the host firewall does not govern it
planned_action: Bind sensitive services to localhost or the private network, add DOCKER-USER rules, and remove redundant rules

title: LAN traffic in plain HTTP
description: Someone on the home network reads or changes traffic to services reached by local name
planned_action: Add internal TLS for local names where practical

title: Outdated software with known flaws
description: A pinned image falls behind and a known flaw is exploited from the LAN or the private network
planned_action: Set a monthly update review and watch advisories for the services in use

title: Outside supplier unavailable
description: A supplier such as the private network provider or the home automation relay has an outage
planned_action: Local access still works. Remote access resumes when the supplier does

title: Private network access rules too permissive
description: Any device on the private network can reach every service, so one lost device exposes all of them
planned_action: Write access rules that limit each device group to the services it needs

title: Security events go unnoticed
description: Repeated login failures or odd behavior are not seen because logs are not reviewed or alerted on
planned_action: Collect key logs in one place and alert on login failures

title: Stale or incomplete documentation
description: Out-of-date documentation leads to wrong decisions, missed reviews, or a recovery that follows the wrong steps
csf_subcategories: GV.PO-01, GV.PO-02, ID.AM-03, ID.AM-07, ID.AM-08, PR.PS-03
planned_action: Complete the missing documents and hold a first policy review
